# ComplyOS — LLM Context

ComplyOS is an L&D Compliance & Learning Operations MCP Server. It audits compliance training gaps across enterprise LMS platforms.

## Architecture
- Python/FastAPI backend with FastMCP for AI agent integration
- SQLite local-first data store
- Connector pattern for LMS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Cornerstone)
- Evidence ledger for audit trails
- CLI and MCP server interfaces

## Key Files
- `complyos/core/auditor.py` — Gap auditing engine
- `complyos/connectors/` — LMS connectors
- `complyos/api/mcp_server.py` — MCP tool definitions
- `complyos/cli.py` — CLI entry point

## MCP Tools
- `audit_compliance_gaps(department?, region?)` — Find missing training
- `get_user_compliance_status(user_id)` — Single user status
- `generate_audit_report(department?, region?)` — Structured report
- `check_connector_health()` — LMS connection status

## Running Tests
```bash
pytest tests/ -v --cov=complyos --cov-branch
```
